Generate recorded — and that closes the loop on CHG-004: the approval is already on the ledger, the spec sits Ready, open items are at zero, and the document itself pins the grain at story level per your ruling. One-breath recap of the settled intent: when a task reaches terminal-done — confirmed auto-publication or a polled MERGED PR — the workflow reclaims that task's worktrees (directories, registrations, and every per-base integration sibling) and its Packet-created local branches: Git's strict merged check first, attested deletion only under the full four-limb conjunction, and anything less kept with a recorded reason. Dirty, non-terminal, or foreign candidates are never touched, and a cleanup failure stays a pure diagnostic that cannot slow publication or the queue. The story batch enters the auto queue behind the two stories currently in flight; each arrives independently verifiable. No further decisions needed from you until a story raises its hand.
